title: State of the Trenches, 2026-W47: fees −6.2% week over week
dek: Launchpad fees were $12.99M across 14 non-overlapping venues and creator earnings $5.86M; GTA 6 launch coins led narrative volume.

body.text: The covered launchpad fee subtotal for 2026-W47 (Nov 16, 2026 to Nov 22, 2026, UTC) was $12.99M across 14 non-overlapping venues, −6.2% against 2026-W46 on the same venues. 5 venues that share a fee stream with another venue are reported individually and never added.
Creator earnings — fees paid to coin creators and, depending on the venue's own definition, holders, referrers or traders — were $5.86M across 16 venues that define them, −14.5% week over week.
By share of the subtotal, pump.fun gained the most (+5.9 points) and LaunchLab lost the most (-2.7 points). A share shift says where fees moved, not why.

Trading in the coins of the tracked narratives totalled $329.6M for the week, counting a coin once when it belongs to more than one narrative (the per-narrative totals add up to $329.6M). This is the volume of identified coins across their indexed pools, not of the whole market.

GTA 6 launch coins carried the most volume among narratives collected during the week: $140.93M (partial: some member-days were not observed). On the 9 members fully observed in both weeks, volume changed −12.4%.
First observed this week: Marvin the Martian coins. A narrative's first week has no meaningful prior week, so no change is reported for it.
Collection paused during the week: GTA 6 Dacity Coin coins, Marvin the Martian coins. Their members stay members; their totals after the pause are partial, not zero.
